physical_subject: What does the delay of an echo reveal about distance?
relationship: For colocated stationary transmitter and receiver, reflector distance is half the product of sound speed and round-trip delay.
operation: Send and return one marker along the same measured path, then halve distance and delay.
closest_prior: flow/01-doppler: moving source changes wave spacing; objects/05-walk: harmonic average
substantive_difference: Stationary pulse time of flight estimates geometric distance using two path legs, not moving-source pitch or unequal-speed averaging.
